connect_p_gui: connect to pybullet in GUI mode for interactive 3D simulation rendering
set_additional_search_path: set the additional search path for pybullet data assets using pybullet_data.getDataPath
load_plugin: load a compiled pybullet plugin DLL by specifying its file path and name
execute_plugin_command: execute a command on a loaded pybullet plugin with URDF and numeric arguments
step_simulation: step the pybullet simulation forward one timestep inside a continuous loop
